|----------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 Ranged 10**                       | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Reason](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason):**

- **≤11:** 2 + R corruption damage
- **12-16:** 4 + R corruption damage
- **17+:** 6 + R corruption damage
